title: Structure the Bakery Page
prompt:
The boilerplate has content dumped in plain `div`s. Restructure it using semantic elements — do not change the visible text.

Requirements:
- Wrap the site name in a `<header>`.
- Put the two links in a `<nav>`.
- Wrap ALL page content in exactly one `<main>` (it should contain the sections).
- Turn the two content blocks into `<section>` elements, each keeping its own heading.
- Add a `<footer>` containing the copyright paragraph.
boilerplate:
Ada's Bakery

Bread Cakes

Bread

Sourdough baked daily.

Cakes

To order on Fridays.

© 2026 Ada's Bakery

tests.name: has a header
tests.hint: <header> holds introductory content like the site name.

tests.name: has a nav containing the links
tests.hint: <nav> is for major navigation — move both <a> links inside it.

tests.name: exactly one main
tests.hint: Wrap the two sections in one <main> — screen readers jump straight to it.

tests.name: sections kept with headings
tests.hint: A section is a thematic grouping *with a heading* — keep the <h2> inside each.

tests.name: footer with copyright
tests.hint: Closing content like © belongs in a <footer>.
